scope.profile: Exact ordered signed pairs, root-owned relation list, cached active count, material gate, nonzero element field imports and flat-prefix resize across2D/3D; one object, two materials, three relations, two elements, widths<=3.

behavior: PHASTF scans two stream integers. Exact ordered signed keys select a stable insertion-order record; missing pairs append before payload read. Keys need not identify existing materials. Reversed keys identify another record.

Mode reader zeroes its local and applies zero/partial output even on failure. Nonzero mode sets active=1, recounts records whose active is exactly1, then refreshes with option0. Zero mode sets active=0 without recount or refresh; cached root13f4 can remain stale and differs from list count.

Component51(DVOLF) and52(TICF) use cached13f4 only when feature49 is enabled by root85c or a material mode1cc8==1. Root85c stayszero in these captures; MSTMTR supplies the exercised gate. Refresh can occur while the gate is off, yielding zero widths.

PHASTF option0 performs no material-rank or relation-key permutation. Active objects use ordinary descriptor resize with previous/current shape history. Existing flat prefix survives; growth appends zero values and shrink discards suffix. For two rows, width1 [11,22] becomes width2 [11,22,0,0].

DVOLF/TICF mode1 uses live root width and explicit or implicit input width. Default fill, min(input,destination) row copies, retained complete rows before failure, scalar bytes and stream positions match the original. Explicit wider input consumes every scalar before bounded destination copies.

Dimension reset clears relation ownership and cachedcount; same dimension preserves them. Material gate changes and failed payloads preserve the exact observed ordering.
